claims.assertion: Yazhi says each soul chooses its perceptions; she frames her Earth experience as a chosen challenge and role.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi presents her warnings as a perspective and urges people to decide what to believe for themselves; she says no outside source holds all truth.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi describes the Cabal as layered to confuse and control, with further layers beneath any layer that is breached.
claims.speaker: Yazhi

claims.assertion: Yazhi suspects many purportedly benevolent military operations are psychological operations, while allowing limited factional conflicts.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She lacks facts about individual operations.
